newsitem.title: MALTA: Fewer arrivals at Malta airport.
newsitem.headline: Fewer arrivals at Malta airport.

text.p: A total of 2,443,502 passengers flew to and from Malta last year, a four per cent drop on the previous 12 months, Malta International Airport said in its annual report on Wednesday.
Cargo figures showed a total of 9,403 tonnes for last year compared to 11,613 in 1995 and 11,161 in 1994.
In 1994, the number of passengers arrivals and departures was 2,564,661, the figure dropping to 2,541,230 in 1995.
"In terms of traffic to and from the airport, last year cannot be recorded among the most exciting in our history," said MIA chairman Nick Degiorgio.

"Indeed it is an accomplishment that our company registered growth and significant development of its various businesses despite the four per cent downturn in passengers handled at the airport during 1996," he added.

He did not specify by how much business has grown, but MIA over the past year increased the number of shops in its duty-free section and opened new facilities for airport visitors including a new restaurant.
The highest number of passengers was to and from Britain, at 939,193, but that was also where the drop was steepest, as 11 percent.
Air Malta transported a total of 1,364,124 passengers last year compared to 1,398,548 in 1995 making it the number one operator.
Tourism to Malta last year dropped by over six percent. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
